name: UK Medical Records
description: UK hospital and GP records. Detects NHS numbers, UK dates (dd/mm/yyyy and long form), UK postcodes, UK phone numbers, National Insurance numbers, hospital numbers and patient names. Preserves lab values and clinical scores — numbers with decimals or commas are left untouched.

patterns.name: NHS Number
patterns.description: 10-digit NHS number, plain or in 3-3-4 format (e.g. 943 476 5919). Guarded so decimals and longer runs don't match.

patterns.name: Hospital / MRN number
patterns.description: 6+ contiguous digits with no adjacent digit, period or comma — hospital numbers, local patient IDs. Preserves lab values like 12.4 or 1,234.56 and short numbers.

patterns.name: UK date (dd/mm/yyyy)
patterns.description: Day-first UK date — dd/mm/yyyy or dd-mm-yyyy, 4-digit year

patterns.name: UK date (dd/mm/yy, short year)
patterns.description: Day-first date with 2-digit year (e.g. 05/03/62) — disabled by default, enable for older records

patterns.name: Date (DD Month YYYY)
patterns.description: Long-form UK date — '5 January 1980' or '5th January 1980'

patterns.name: UK postcode
patterns.description: UK postcode — e.g. SW1A 1AA, M1 1AE, B33 8TH (case-sensitive)

patterns.name: National Insurance number
patterns.description: UK NI number — e.g. QQ 12 34 56 C or AB123456C
